newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: World July air cargo traffic up 9.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: World July air cargo traffic up 9.1 pct.

text.p: Cargo traffic handled by 488 airports around the world rose 9.1 percent in July over a year ago, led by Africa with a 35 percent growth, the Geneva-based Airports Council International (ACI) said on Tuesday.
Cargo traffic at African airports grew 35.2 percent in July to 56,092 tonnes, the ICI said.
North America, the biggest of ACI's six cargo-handling regions, reported 2.12 million tonnes of cargo traffic, up 12.3 percent over July 1995.
Volume at ACI's Europe member airports totalled 826,888 tonnes in July, up 3.5 percent over the same 1995 period.
Cargo at airports in the Asia/Pacific region -- in which ACI incorporates Indo-China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Thailand, Japan, Malaysia and Australia -- totalled 843,668 tonnes, up 4.4 percent.
Cargo traffic rose 11.2 percent to 135,431 tonnes at Middle East airports and 18.1 percent to 111,750 tonnes in Latin America/Caribbean.
